'''Mercenaries' Ridge''' was an area of the [[Karthakk system]] which served as [[Lok/Legends|Lok's]] most popular [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump from the outer [[Planet/Legends|planets]] to the "serenity" of Lok's [[Star system/Legends|space system]]. Only authorized persons with approved [[Paper/Legends|papers]] signed by an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] could jump there with ease. However, most [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and thieves traveling through the region possessed counterfeit papers and, with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] dealing with [[Nym/Legends|Nym]], no one was the wiser.<ref name="JTL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mercenaries' Ridge was a location in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], the [[2004]] expansion pack for the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="JTL" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
